# NFL Daily — 2026-10-30 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- Panthers fired DC Ejiro Evero and pass-game coordinator Jonathan Cooley after Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers — the league's first in-season coordinator firing this year; DL coach Todd Wash takes over as interim DC. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50328239/panthers-relieve-ejiro-evero-defensive-coordinator-duties)
- Packers WR Christian Watson left Thursday's win over the Panthers for an in-game hospital visit with a chest injury, then returned to play. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7737433/2026/10/29/christian-watson-packers-chest-injury-hospital/)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-30 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- Lamar Jackson is set to return Sunday at Buffalo after missing three games with a high ankle sprain, cleared with no injury designation; he called the pain "bearable" and said he no longer feels like "a statue." [Hensley](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50329330/ravens-qb-lamar-jackson-expected-return-vs-bills)
- Coach Jesse Minter says the Ravens are "too much of a momentum team," with beat writers noting no player has stepped up to fill the locker room's leadership void. [The Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-jesse-minter-momentum-problem-B5Y7N23QLND5LA4SHXMWKWN4HU/)
